name: Northlake Plumbing — plumber serving Austin and area, United States

identity.place: serves Austin, Round Rock and Pflugerville, Texas (US)

what_it_does.text: Northlake Plumbing repairs and replaces plumbing in homes and small rental buildings in Austin, Round Rock and Pflugerville, Texas. It finds and fixes leaks, clears blocked drains and installs gas and electric water heaters, standard and tankless, and gives a fixed price before work starts. It works at the customer's property and has no walk-in shop.
what_it_does.specialties: tankless water heaters, slab leak detection
